description: Currency, money arithmetic, allocation and exchange (measure contract section 2). currency: the code, expect its minor units or error CURRENCY_UNKNOWN. plus, minus, times, round, compare, sum, allocate and exchange: inputs as {amount, currency} objects with string amounts; expect is a money object (amount keeps its scale), a number for compare, an array for sum and allocate; round has scale null for the currency's minor units.
howToRun: Build the money values from the strings, apply the operation, compare amounts as plain text and currencies as codes with expect, or the error code with error. Allocation parts are in order.
